subject: general
question: The National Anti-Doping Bill was passed in the Lok Sabha on July 27, 2022. Which of the following organisation manage and administer doping control programs in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Anti-Doping Agency (NADA)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **National Anti-Doping Agency (NADA) **is the apex body in India that is responsible for promoting, coordinating, and monitoring the doping control program in sports.
